messages:
mira: Morning — kicking off phased launch for feature_x. Starting 5% canary in eu-west1 now. Targets: 5 → 20 → 50 over ~90 min if healthy. Ping @eng-sre, @eng-runtime, @support.

deploy-bot: deploy started: canary-feature_x-eu-west1 id=deploy_1854321 status=IN_PROGRESS

sam: Pushed routing tweak to prefer low-latency kernels. Watching p50/p95 — saw p95 +40ms at ~2m mark, looks like KV cache warmup.

ana: Observability check — no 5xx in the last 10m, error budget at 99.98% for this slice. Created alert: prod.feature_x.p99 > 400ms for 2m -> page.

david: FYI I ran the feature-flag ramp script for us-east1 to 10% earlier and paused because autoscaling was trimming instance count too fast. Increased min-replicas.

mira: Rollback criteria: any sustained p99 > 500ms for 3m, or error rate >0.2% for 5m. Also manual rollback if customer-impacting 5xx spikes. I'll call rollback.

jon: Client SDK change merged — new blackbox token logic; no client-side flag needed. PS: serverside flag names: `feature_x` / `feature_x_variant_b`.

sarah: Support reporting 2 dev customers hit intermittent 503s (non-prod). No prod reports. Keeping an eye. :eyes: 

sam: Observed transient 503s from one canary pod from GPU OOM? logs: `OOMKilled` once, restarted. Still < threshold.

ana: Took that pod out of rotation and set canary to 0% in eu-west1 temporarily. Command I ran: `flags set feature_x eu-west1=0` — will re-enable once stable.

mira: Thanks. New plan: hold global ramp for 30 min while infra stabilizes; keep feature at 10% us-east and 0% eu-west1. Next check in 30m. Anything blocking from product side? :raised_hands: 

david: Nothing from infra. I'll coordinate autoscaler tuning in the next 15m.

sarah: No escalations. I'll draft a short blurb for CS to send if rollout goes wider.

sam: I'll follow up on OOM root cause — possible quantization memory regression from the model bundle. If confirmed, I'll pin previous bundle and re-roll.

deploy-bot: deploy update: canary-feature_x-eu-west1 id=deploy_1854321 status=PAUSED

mira: Great — thanks all. Marking this thread for async standup. Ping here for any updates. :white_check_mark:
